A=1/(16\epsilon^2),\quad r=H_{2\epsilon}(c)/H_\epsilon(c).
\]

\[
\boxed{Q_\epsilon(c)\le\min\{\tfrac23A,\ A(\tfrac7{10}-\tfrac8{15}r)\}.}
